tools_helpful.evidence: Source files copied verbatim into target with TODO anchors; both scenario pages, SampleConfiguration/Helpers, and XAML present in migrated app with full visible text and control fidelity (score 75, feature 2 pass).

tool_limitations.limitation: The verbatim-text check inspects XAML only (SKILL.md Fidelity bullet, line 181), so a dropped logic statement in a .cs code-behind edit is unguarded.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Sharpen the Fidelity guidance so the agent self-verifies .cs surgical edits (compiler + XAML check cannot catch a dropped assignment).

special_apis.special_handling: Capability-gated: on a box without Wi-Fi tethering the helper path surfaces a specific NotifyUser message and returns null gracefully. In the desktop/unpackaged target this path threw, so the added defensive try/catch caught it and showed the generic message instead (D2).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Migrated ApplyChanges_Click is missing 'configuration.Ssid = SsidTextBox.Text;' present in the UWP original; an edited SSID would silently not persist.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Surgical string-replace intended only to add a '!' null-forgiving operator to m_tetheringManager. The old_str widened to include the following statement 'configuration.Ssid = SsidTextBox.Text;' but the new_str omitted it — collateral deletion of real logic. Clean build, so neither compiler nor the XAML-only verbatim check flagged it.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved by the agent; caught later by parity code review (D1). Cost requirement #1 pass->partial (score 75).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Fidelity rule: in a targeted .cs edit, reproduce every line of the match window verbatim except the single transformed line; re-read the replaced block to confirm the only diff is the intended transform.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: On the gated machine the WinUI app shows generic 'This sample could not initialize on this machine. <ex>' instead of the UWP's specific 'This app is not configured to access Wi-Fi devices on this machine.' (D2, minor).
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Agent correctly added the skill's Defensive-UI try/catch around init, but the blanket catch's generic fallback masked the source's own capability-specific NotifyUser message (which the Helpers path still contains).
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved; behaviorally equivalent (both show red error), verdict pass, minor.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Defensive-UI guidance: preserve a source-specific failure message when the source already surfaces one; use the generic fallback only when the source had none.

env_issues.issue: Both scenarios hardware-gated (no Wi-Fi tethering capability), HotspotPanel collapsed in UWP and WinUI alike.
env_issues.workaround: Grade against gated ground-truth state + source-level control/handler fidelity.
